title: fleet view — task-dashboard instance for agent work across machines
description:
# fleet view plan

**Goal:** build the second task-dashboard instance specified in
`dev_docs/designs/2026-10-23-fleet-view.md` (PR #1096). It runs on the Mac
mini, is read from the phone over the tailnet, and covers agent work across the
Mac mini, the MacBook and lindev: Claude sessions, PRs, issues, worktrees and
handoffs. It leads with the one decision that needs the owner, and it replaces
the work-in-progress reset design's manual re-measure with a live Health panel.

## Scope / non-goals

- **Builds on milestone #13** (the Jira instance). It reuses that milestone's
  engine and does not fork it:
  - generic work items (#1089)
  - the server and its guard (#1090)
  - the views and score (#1091)
  - the overlay (#1092)
  - the install (#1093)
- **Not in scope:**
  - answering prompts or approvals from the view (dotfiles#1013)
  - messaging between sessions (dotfiles#1020)
  - enforcing caps
  - the work laptop, and any Jira data
- **No LLM at runtime.** A decision brief is read from where an agent already
  wrote it: a session's post-turn summary, or the PR body. The view never
  writes one.

## Approach

**The collector side:**

- An opt-in session-state hook (task 2) records exact turn and prompt times on
  every opted-in machine.
- A per-machine collector (tasks 5–6) snapshots local state and pushes it to
  the Mac mini's ingest endpoint (task 7).

**The aggregator side**, on the Mac mini:

- It reads Claude Code Remote (task 3) and GitHub (task 4) directly.
- Views (tasks 8–11) are added to the existing server.

**The main risk is task 1.** If a background process can't read the Claude Code
Remote session list, Needs you depends on the hook alone, and sessions that run
only in the cloud become invisible. So task 1 runs first, and task 3's shape
depends on what it finds.

## Tasks

| #  | Task                                                                                                       | Runs on                   | Blocked by        |
| -- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------- |
| 1  | [[fleet_view_task_1]] spike: can a background process read the Claude Code Remote session list?            | Mac mini                  | —                 |
| 2  | [[fleet_view_task_2]] opt-in session-state hook                                                            | Mac mini                  | —                 |
| 3  | [[fleet_view_task_3]] Claude Code Remote sessions adapter                                                  | Mac mini                  | 1, #1089          |
| 4  | [[fleet_view_task_4]] GitHub adapter: issues, design docs, review queue, decision briefs                   | Mac mini                  | #1088, #1089      |
| 5  | [[fleet_view_task_5]] machine snapshot builder (worktrees, handoffs, tmux, hook tails, prompt history)     | Mac mini                  | 2                 |
| 6  | [[fleet_view_task_6]] collector scheduling and push (`launchd`, `systemd --user`)                          | Mac mini, then lindev     | 5, 7              |
| 7  | [[fleet_view_task_7]] ingest endpoint and snapshot adapter                                                 | Mac mini                  | 5, #1089, #1090   |
| 8  | [[fleet_view_task_8]] overlay additions, gauges, focus pin                                                 | Mac mini                  | #1092             |
| 9  | [[fleet_view_task_9]] Needs you view                                                                       | Mac mini                  | 3, 4, 7, 8, #1091 |
| 10 | [[fleet_view_task_10]] Since you were away and Stale views                                                 | Mac mini                  | 4, 7, 8           |
| 11 | [[fleet_view_task_11]] Health panel                                                                        | Mac mini                  | 4, 7, 8           |
| 12 | [[fleet_view_task_12]] deploy on three machines and run live acceptance                                    | Mac mini, MacBook, lindev | 6, 9, 10, 11, #1093 |
| 13 | [[fleet_view_task_13]] move lasting knowledge into a live doc and retire the plan                          | Mac mini                  | 12                |
| 14 | [[fleet_view_task_14]] add a "Decision brief" section to the PR authoring convention (in agent-guidance)    | Mac mini                  | —                 |

**Order:**

1. Tasks 1, 2 and 14 can start now. They don't depend on milestone #13.
2. Task 4 can start once #1088 and #1089 land, and task 8 once #1092 lands.
3. Tasks 9–11 fan out three wide once their inputs land.

## Decisions

- **Decision briefs come from the PR authoring convention.** Task 14 adds a
  `## Decision brief` section to `agent-guidance`'s
  `authoring_pull_requests.md`, and task 4 reads it. Until that lands, PR
  cards fall back to title, age and CI state.
- **Empty Remote spawns are listed under Stale**, with "no prompt since
  <date>" as their evidence. They are not hidden.
- **lindev has `uv`**, so task 6 installs the collector there as written.
